annuity-fv-inv.name: Annuity Future Value Calculator
annuity-fv-inv.intro: Compute the future value of a level periodic investment from PMT, per-period rate r and period count n using FV = PMT·[(1+r)^n − 1]/r.

annuity-pv-inv.name: Annuity Present Value Calculator
annuity-pv-inv.intro: Compute the present value of an annuity from cash flow PMT, rate r and periods n using PV = PMT·[1 − (1+r)^(−n)]/r.

bond-price.name: Bond Price Calculator
bond-price.intro: Price a bond by discounting its cash flows from face value, coupon rate, yield to maturity and term to maturity.

bond-ytm-approx.name: Bond Yield to Maturity (Approximate)
bond-ytm-approx.intro: Estimate bond yield to maturity from annual coupon C, face value F, current price P and years to maturity n using YTM ≈ [C + (F−P)/n] / [(F+P)/2].

discounted-payback.name: Discounted Payback Period Calculator
discounted-payback.intro: Find the year when cumulative discounted cash flows turn positive from periodic cash flows and a discount rate, accounting for time value of money.

dividend-payout-ratio.name: Dividend Payout Ratio Calculator
dividend-payout-ratio.intro: Compute dividend payout ratio DPR = DPS / EPS from dividends per share and earnings per share.

dividend-yield.name: Dividend Yield Calculator
dividend-yield.intro: Compute dividend yield as annual dividend divided by share price.

eps-calc.name: EPS Calculator
eps-calc.intro: Compute earnings per share (EPS) from net profit and shares outstanding.

future-value-inv.name: Future Value Calculator
future-value-inv.intro: Compute future value from present value PV, annual rate r and years n using FV = PV·(1+r)^n.

geometric-mean-return.name: Geometric Mean Return Calculator
geometric-mean-return.intro: Compute the compounded annual return from a series of period returns (comma or space separated) using g = (Π(1+rᵢ))^(1/n) − 1.

holding-period-return.name: Holding Period Return Calculator
holding-period-return.intro: Compute total return including dividends from buy price, sell price and dividends received during the holding period.

irr-calc.name: Internal Rate of Return (IRR) Calculator
irr-calc.intro: Compute the internal rate of return from period cash flows using bisection search for the discount rate that makes NPV = 0.

npv-calc.name: Net Present Value (NPV) Calculator
npv-calc.intro: Compute net present value from period cash flows and a discount rate; NPV > 0 indicates an acceptable project.

payback-period.name: Payback Period Calculator
payback-period.intro: Compute the number of years for cumulative cash flows to turn positive — the time needed to recover the initial investment.

pe-ratio.name: P/E Ratio Calculator
pe-ratio.intro: Compute the price-to-earnings valuation multiple from share price and earnings per share.

portfolio-beta.name: Portfolio Beta Calculator
portfolio-beta.intro: Compute portfolio beta β_p = Σ wᵢ·βᵢ from the weights and betas of two assets (w₁ + w₂ = 1).

present-value-inv.name: Present Value Calculator
present-value-inv.intro: Compute present value from future amount FV, discount rate r and years n using PV = FV / (1+r)^n.

profitability-index.name: Profitability Index Calculator
profitability-index.intro: Compute profitability index from the present value of benefits and the initial investment, used to rank mutually exclusive projects.

real-rate-return.name: Real Rate of Return Calculator
real-rate-return.intro: Compute the inflation-adjusted real return r_real = (1+r_nom)/(1+i) − 1 from the nominal return and the inflation rate.

retention-ratio.name: Retention Ratio Calculator
retention-ratio.intro: Compute the retention ratio b = 1 − DPR from the dividend payout ratio, measuring the share of profit reinvested.

roi-calc.name: ROI Calculator
roi-calc.intro: Compute return on investment from gain and cost as a simple ratio for quick profitability comparison across projects.

sortino-ratio.name: Sortino Ratio Calculator
sortino-ratio.intro: Compute the Sortino ratio from portfolio return, risk-free rate and downside deviation — a downside-risk-only alternative to the Sharpe ratio.

sustainable-growth.name: Sustainable Growth Rate Calculator
sustainable-growth.intro: Compute the sustainable growth rate g = ROE × b from return on equity and retention ratio, assuming no new equity issuance.

yield-spread.name: Bond Yield Spread Calculator
yield-spread.intro: Compute the yield spread Spread = y_bond − y_bench between a bond yield and a benchmark yield for relative value and credit risk assessment.
